title: source-control team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/source-control.yaml, the team layer of the source-control plugin's YAML settings. Each key here wins over the plugin's userConfig value of the same name. Resolution: plugins/source-control/reference/config-resolution.md.

pr_open_state.description: State /source-control:pull-request create opens a pull request in. draft opens a draft that /source-control:pull-request ready later flips; ready opens it ready for review.
